summary: Four previously untested live host scenarios passed
tested: Real Claude primary and supervision engine; observed Git refs, durable task inboxes, queue state, and lifecycle metadata across repeated wakes
testing_summary: The earlier 429 usage limit was an external quota blocker. After its reset, real Claude executed successfully; all four requested autonomous scenarios passed at the unchanged target commit. No source, test, documentation, global configuration, or production credential changes were needed. Only focused live validation ran; no broad suite, linter, formatter, pipeline control, push, PR, or CI phase ran. The disposable lab and private tmux server were removed and git status was clean.

scenarios.name: The real supervision host lands standing-approved work under observation-only away words
scenarios.reason: Real Claude Code 2.1.325 advanced local main from 290dbb587895080c98571e351174fbbd72a83faa to validated head 69cf19a7c4455241dd41e19dae4f22a0aab9130e with task and registry yolo off. Observation-only words were unchanged. Dispatch metadata remained byte-identical and the restricted sibling remained unmerged. The same conversation handled a follow-up wake.

scenarios.name: The real supervision host grants overnight suite slots in request order without exceeding the house limit
scenarios.reason: Real Claude granted slot1 first, made slot2 wait for slot1 and slot3 for slot2, refused a renewed slot2 ask while slot1 was running, then granted slot2 only after slot1 released and slot3 only after slot2 released. The unrelated design decision remained open. These were disposable status/inbox request fixtures with live placeholder endpoints; no real full suites were run, and worker receipt was not claimed.

scenarios.name: The real supervision host preserves explicit task restrictions and holds work outside standing approval
scenarios.reason: Restricted and outside-scope branches remained unmerged. The explicit task restriction continued to hold when the demo registry was switched to +yolo as an adversarial fixture condition; the unrelated other project stayed at its initial main head.

scenarios.name: The away session dispatches eligible queued work under existing authority without renewed away instructions
scenarios.reason: A real Claude primary parked MAIN and the real host handled check: away-entry-review after an unchanged-words entry refresh. The host itself invoked fm-spawn, allocating an isolated native Git worker with mode local-only and yolo on under standing approval while registry yolo remained off. The queue became in_flight. After accepting the Codex folder-trust dialog only in its isolated worktree-local configuration, the real worker fixed queued_answer.txt, committed, and was later landed and closed by the host. No manual spawn was used.

limitations: Scheduling evidence is real model decisions and durable inbox delivery against disposable status requests, not actual full-suite processes.

The queued worker broad file check also identified pre-existing answer.txt=0; the changed queued_answer.txt check passed. The host disclosed the baseline failure and left the unrelated file unchanged. Dispatch proof does not rely on this later landing.
The focused credentialed regression uses a lock-holder fixture and real Claude engine; the additional integrated scenarios use a real Claude primary in a marked disposable home.
